issues_encountered.issue: Database connection failure - hostname not resolving
issues_encountered.root_cause: Supabase changed infrastructure, old db.* hostname no longer exists
issues_encountered.solution: Updated connection string from db.tqztcoypkdhjpbkqhyxd.supabase.co to aws-1-us-east-1.pooler.supabase.com
issues_encountered.lesson: Database hostnames can change when infrastructure is migrated. Always check DNS resolution when connection fails unexpectedly.

issues_encountered.issue: Prisma db push failed with 'prepared statement already exists'
issues_encountered.root_cause: Using transaction pooler (port 6543) with pgbouncer=true for migrations
issues_encountered.solution: Use direct connection (port 5432) or session pooler for migrations, transaction pooler only for queries
issues_encountered.lesson: Prisma migrations require direct connection or session mode pooler. Transaction pooler doesn't support prepared statements needed for migrations.

issues_encountered.issue: Decimal objects cannot be passed to Client Components
issues_encountered.root_cause: Prisma returns Decimal objects, Next.js serialization doesn't support them
issues_encountered.solution: Added serializeCollege() helper to explicitly convert Decimal fields to numbers using Number()
issues_encountered.lesson: Always serialize Prisma Decimal/DateTime/JSON fields in server actions before passing to Client Components. Use Number() for Decimals, toISOString() for dates.

issues_encountered.issue: Fix appeared not to work initially
issues_encountered.root_cause: Next.js dev server caches server actions, didn't pick up code changes
issues_encountered.solution: Restart dev server to reload server action code
issues_encountered.lesson: Server action changes require dev server restart. Create test API endpoint to verify fix works before claiming success.

issues_encountered.issue: Pushed commits without verifying they work
issues_encountered.root_cause: Assumed serialization fix worked without testing in browser
issues_encountered.solution: User correctly called out - must test/verify before pushing
issues_encountered.lesson: CRITICAL: Follow proper validation flow: 1) Reproduce issue, 2) Apply fix, 3) Verify fix works, 4) THEN commit/push. Never push without verification.

patterns_discovered.details: Use port 5432 for migrations, port 6543 for queries. Transaction pooler (?pgbouncer=true) not compatible with migrations.
Must explicitly convert non-plain objects (Decimal, Date, etc) to plain types in server actions. JSON.stringify won't automatically handle these.
Server actions are cached by Next.js dev server. Changes require restart. Client components hot reload fine.
1. Reproduce and see issue, 2. Apply fix, 3. Verify it works, 4. Then commit. Never skip step 3.
